name: Albemarle Corporation
blurb: Albemarle is one of the world's largest producers of lithium compounds, supplying battery-grade lithium hydroxide and carbonate to electric-vehicle and energy-storage markets. It also produces bromine and specialty chemicals. The company holds roughly 16% of global lithium market share and operates mines in Chile, Australia, and the United States. Its AI revenue exposure is indirect — lithium's primary demand driver remains EV batteries — but data-center battery backup systems and robotics batteries create a secondary link.
recent: Albemarle has faced significant margin pressure through 2025 and into 2026 as lithium spot prices remained well below 2022 peaks amid a supply glut and slower-than-expected EV adoption in key markets. The company has responded by curtailing production and deferring expansion projects. AI-related demand for lithium is real but remains a small fraction of total consumption.
